papers_and_supporting_note.scope: For every finite Galois E/K over a complete nontrivially valued K and every actual good separated strict boundaryless pure n-dimensional K-analytic X, n>=1, finite continuous real h has ordinary zero Hessian iff its scalar pullback does, against every compact complementary (n-1,n-1) form. Wild ramification, all components and actual nilpotent generic lengths are retained. Reverse transport uses canonical scalar projection without a degree factor. Completed-algebraic, mixed-finite, transcendental transport, classical recognition and two-sign ordinary smooth regularization are not claimed.
